integrity: The proof reconstructs the local divisibility pattern from multiplicative order and lifting-the-exponent identities, handles p=2 separately, and is accompanied by an exact finite consistency checker over 1700 pair-prime cases.
limitations: The theorem treats coprime companion Lucas sequences with positive square discriminant and nonzero terms. It does not classify nonsquare discriminants, repeated-root cases, the degenerate P=0 branch, or U(P,Q). Bibliographic novelty remains subject to unindexed prior work.
title: All local prime parts are Dold for split companion Lucas sequences
